rule: Every workflow must have an explicit role, trigger, mutation target, deployment target, authority owner, and lifecycle status before the optimization gate may become GREEN.
removal_basis: Each removed workflow was independently inspected and explicitly marked DISABLED or RETIRED in its own source, and each pointed to a newer/canonical renderer or lane. None was a live execution authority. Git history preserves the deleted artifacts.
preservation_basis: This workflow is an explicit fail-closed boundary, not an obsolete deployer: it blocks the GitHub 509 lane from substituting for the unresolved Assistant Cloudflare/live lane. It must remain until runtime authority is reconciled.
remaining_required_work: Identify mutation and deployment targets for every remaining workflow.
Resolve Assistant Cloudflare/live authority against authoritative external configuration or an authorized execution surface.
Do not substitute the GitHub 509 lane for the Assistant lane.

known_workflow_families.role: Separate GitHub 509 lane; preserved fail-closed world-class boundary must not be silently treated as Assistant Cloudflare/live authority.
Remaining generations must be classified by mutation/deploy/test responsibility.
Remaining builders/validators must be classified against the canonical renderer.
Retired duplicate 509 authorities removed; remaining authorities require explicit ownership.
Current authorized release mechanism/target remains unresolved. Historical expected canonical-v2 path is not sufficient proof.

required_completion: Enumerate every remaining workflow file, classify KEEP/CONSOLIDATE/MANUAL/RETIRE/HISTORICAL, identify every file mutation and deployment target, then reduce to one explicit authority per mutation/deployment boundary without deleting required current functionality.
